verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the thumbnail's no-AI-assets policy and the limited Photoshop Generative Fill exception; the delivery deadline is correctly excluded.
The client prohibits using generative AI to create elements or alter parts of photographs.
The client defines the permitted editing behavior as limited Photoshop Generative Fill touch-ups such as removing a background prop.
The client explicitly prohibits wholesale AI alteration of the photograph.

value_updates.external_generative_ai_image_upload_edit: The client would probably veto uploading images to external generative AI tools and asking them to make changes.

verdicts.decision_note: The external-AI image-editing workflow is implementation-relevant, but the source expresses a probable veto rather than an absolute prohibition.
The client explicitly classifies wholesale AI generation from existing photographs as prohibited thumbnail-production behavior.
The client unambiguously accepts the proposal that assets be made manually in Photoshop, with AI limited to minor Generative Fill touch-ups.
